annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously requires that when an implementation sends ACK frames in response to a packet that contains frames other than ACK frames, it must also acknowledge any packets that contain only ACK frames. The wording does not allow for two materially different interpretations or a missing constraint that would change implementation behavior.
